descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S22 「Android app（连本地栈的 debug build）和桌面 Chrome：两个模式下的第 2–5 步」 Android app (debug build on the local stack) and desktop Chrome: steps 2-5 in both modes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 The same account is signed in on a phone (app) and a computer (web) at the same time. Signing in on one does not sign out the other, and both stay signed in.（UAT TC-25 step 1；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 9；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry.（UAT TC-25 step 2；UAT TC-25；TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U3 A pre-round note dictated and saved on the computer appears on the phone in real time, with no refresh, and can be continued on the phone without re-entering anything.（UAT TC-25 step 3；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 11；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U4 A note generated on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh.（UAT TC-25 step 4；UAT TC-25；TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time.（UAT TC-25 step 5；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 18；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital.（UAT TC-25 step 6；UAT TC-25；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T3 On the phone app, TC-25's own steps behave as on the web: the same email-code login, and the same add, pre-round save, Generate and delete results.（TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-92570 What） — gate: blocked: TFA-94704 development backlog

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Android emulator with the main debug build pointed at the local stack, signed in with its own email code; desktop Chrome with its own session

When Run S01's steps with the app as the phone, then S02's

Then Same results as S01 and S02 on the real app's WebView

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Same checkpoints as S01/S02, read from the WebView page (android-lane screenshots plus text). Until the lane signs in through the app's own form, its run is not evidence for T1 or TFA-94513 AC 10

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
